metadataRaw.title: How to Improve Your Posture and STAND TALLER
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises to help improve your posture and help you stand taller.

These exercises focus on stretching and strengthening key postural muscles, helping you quickly improve your posture and stand more upright with greater ease.

Each exercise works differently. They target different muscles and are demonstrated in different positions. To get the best results, go through them all and use what works best for you.

Watch now and quickly improve your posture and STAND TALLER!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:48 Standing Exercise
2:10 Bed/Floor Exercise
4:22 Seated Exercise
6:26 Strengthening Exercise 1
8:48 Strengthening Exercise 2
10:03 Strengthening Exercise (Advanced)
